svg.text: Practise containment with a recovery path
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
Defender device page and APP01 VMware console
Verify device isolation is supported for this OS/agent and your plan, and that your role
permits it. Open the VMware console first. Use a disposable member-server pilot, never DC01,
If the action is available and approved for this lab, choose Isolate device, add the practice
reason and confirm. Expect ordinary guest connectivity and its web application to be disrupted
while the Defender control channel is maintained where supported.
Observe the action result and task history. If isolation is unavailable, record the limitation
and practise a separately documented local containment exercise instead; do not pretend it is
Check: The supported containment action has a recorded result and the local console remains
